title: Command: context
lead:
`dlog context [--tag T] [--key-prefix P] [--format md|json]` gives a compact
summary of the accepted decisions.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 5; v1 feature tier; Risks (context bloat); Milestone 3
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** the supersede command itself; a size budget flag (named
only as a Risks mitigation, not in the v1 tier; the owner decides whether to
add it).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal 5: token-cheap context for agents. Output must be deterministic so
`context` diffs are stable.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `query` and `render` modules and CLI tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Only `decided` records appear; `open`, `rejected`, `withdrawn` and
  `superseded` records do not.
- `--tag` and `--key-prefix` filter the output.
- `--format md` and `--format json` both work; the JSON shape is documented.
- Two runs on the same store give byte-identical output.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Select decided records, render a compact summary per record. Gap: PROJECT.md
does not say which fields the compact summary carries; propose a field set in
review.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
